description: This Java source file defines a wrapper class for the FineractEntityRelationRepository, providing methods to retrieve entity relations with exception handling for not found cases. It is part of the domain layer in the infrastructure component of Apache Fineract.

classes.name: FineractEntityRelationRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A service class that provides higher-level access to FineractEntityRelationRepository, including not-found detection and exception handling.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves an entity relation by ID, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: findOneByCodeName
methods.description: Retrieves an entity relation by code name, throwing an exception if not found.
